text: The system shall accept a unit of work from a system inside the platform and from an agent.
rationale: DEC-031 makes every system that cannot continue raise its own work, and DEC-010 makes agents raise work as well. One admission serves both.

text: The system shall refuse a unit of work that does not state the system or the agent that raised it.
rationale: DEC-031 states the contract on both sides. Without the raiser the system cannot report who deposited a unit, and DEC-026 makes the raiser differ from the agent responsible.

text: The system shall give a different state for a unit of work that waits for a person, a unit that waits on the work that it raised, a unit that stopped, and a unit that no agent can perform.
rationale: DEC-005 makes one model for work and makes the state carry the difference between work that waits and work that stopped. DEC-034 makes the fourth a state and not a refusal.

text: The system shall close a unit of work, with the result that the agent responsible for it states, when that agent states that the unit is complete.
rationale: DEC-030 gives this system no judgement, so it does not decide that work is done. The result is stated at the close because REQ-WC-021 serves it to the agent that waits, and because a closed unit with no result cannot be read afterwards.

text: The system shall give, for any unit of work that it holds, the agent responsible for it, the system or the agent that raised it, and its current state.
rationale: REQ-PL-007 states all three. DEC-026 makes the agent that raised a unit differ from the agent responsible for it, so one does not give the other.

text: The system shall give every unit of work that was raised under a given unit of work.
rationale: A caller that asks after a long task cannot follow it by one unit at a time. The set is what makes the task one thing to a reader.

text: The system shall send a unit of work to the agent that the unit names, whether or not a client is attached to that agent.
rationale: REQ-PL-005 directs work to agents. DEC-030 gives this system no judgement, so the unit names its agent. DEC-001 gives the agent an autonomous runtime, and MET-005 states what a caller observes and not the mechanism.

text: The system shall send a unit of work that names no agent to one declared agent.
rationale: A unit with no agent must still reach one. To select an agent by the content of the unit is a judgement, so the system sends it to a declared agent and that agent decides.

text: The system shall refuse a unit of work when the position of the agent that the unit names does not admit the act.
rationale: DEC-019 makes each boundary refuse what the position does not admit, and names this system as one of them. DEC-029 states that a position admits an act.

text: The system shall detect two units of work that name the same declared resource and are held by different agents.
rationale: REQ-PL-006 makes the platform detect contention. To decide priority is a judgement and DEC-030 gives this system none. Detection is possible only where both units name one declared resource, so a resource that nobody declared collides without a report.

text: The system shall raise a unit of work for each contention that it detects.
rationale: DEC-005 makes work one model, so a contention that needs an agent is a unit of work and needs no second mechanism to carry it. The unit names no agent, so REQ-WC-012 sends it to the one declared agent. To name the coordinator here would be a mechanism, and DEC-003 holds that decision instead.

text: The system shall give the result that the agent responsible stated when it closed a unit of work.
rationale: REQ-PL-005 lets an agent get an answer from another agent. DEC-005 makes that ask a unit of work and makes the wait a state, so the answer reaches the agent that asked as the result of the unit that it raised. Without the result the asking agent learns that the work closed and never learns the answer.

text: The system shall accept the declaration of a resource over which it detects contention.
rationale: REQ-PL-006 names a declared resource and nothing in the model declares one. DEC-033 makes an agent declare it, in the shape that DEC-025 set for a kind of item.

text: The system shall refuse the declaration of a resource from an agent whose position does not admit it.
rationale: DEC-019 makes each boundary refuse what a position does not admit. REQ-ST-032 states the same refusal for the declaration of a kind.

text: The system shall refuse a unit of work that names a resource that is not declared.
rationale: A unit that names a resource which nothing declared cannot be matched against another unit, so the contention it would have shown is lost without a report.

text: The system shall not report a unit of work as accepted until it can give that unit again after the platform restarts.
rationale: An answer that the system accepted a unit is what makes the raiser stop holding it. If that answer comes before the unit is durable, the unit is lost and nobody is waiting on it.

text: The system shall report a unit of work that waits on a unit of work that has closed.
rationale: This is the case of RSK-WC-003 that the system can find by itself. A unit that waits for a person who does not answer is held by OPN-004.

text: The system shall report a unit of work that closed with no result while another unit of work waits on it.
rationale: REQ-PL-005 lets an agent get an answer from another agent. A close with no result is the case where the agent that waits gets nothing and cannot tell that it got nothing.

text: The system shall return a unit of work that waits on the work it raised to a state that admits sending when every unit raised under it has closed.
rationale: DEC-005 makes the state carry the difference between work that waits and work that stopped. A unit that stays in the waiting state after its children close reports the wrong one.

text: The system shall not send a unit of work that it has sent before, unless the state of that unit returned to one that admits sending.
rationale: The cause in RSK-WC-006 is a send that the system did not record, so a test of what an agent is doing now does not catch it. The system does not send a unit a second time unless its state says it may, and that holds across a restart.

text: The system shall refuse a unit of work when it cannot confirm the position of the agent that the unit names.
rationale: DEC-019 makes this system one of the boundaries that refuses. A boundary that admits what it cannot check is not a boundary, so the system refuses and does not assume.

text: The system shall report to the raiser of a unit of work each refusal of that unit and the reason for the refusal.
rationale: A raiser that gets silence cannot act. With the reason it can name a different agent, ask an agent whose position admits the act under DEC-026, or raise the work for the user.

text: The system shall name, as the work that caused a unit of work, the unit of work that the raising agent was doing when it raised that unit.
rationale: REQ-PL-007 gives the work that caused a unit. To read what the raising agent is doing is a lookup, so the system supplies the link and does not depend on the agent to name it.

text: The system shall report the number of units of work that it holds and that are not closed.
rationale: A backlog fails nothing, so nothing reports it. The count is what makes lateness visible before the platform is unusable.

text: The system shall not have more than TBD units of work running at one time.
rationale: REQ-PL-020 bounds the recurring cost and the host has two processors. RSK-WC-009 names this requirement, and MET rule 7 keeps a requirement generated from a risk typed safety, so the bound is generated from the function that sends work. The value belongs at subsystem level where the cost of a unit is known, so it is TBD (rule 13).

text: The system shall refuse the declaration of a resource that does not state how the instances of that resource are told apart.
rationale: DEC-036 detects contention between instances and not between classes. A resource that names only a class matches every pair of units that name it.

text: The system shall not give a unit of work to a caller whose position does not admit that unit.
rationale: REQ-PL-024 serves to an agent only the part of what the platform holds that its position admits, and DEC-024 puts the work that is in progress here. An agent that reads every unit of work reads the domains of every other agent.

text: The system shall give the state that no agent can perform the unit of work to each unit whose responsible agent holds a position that the system cannot confirm.
rationale: DEC-046 ends the holding of a position when an agent is retired, and REQ-WC-030 then refuses new work that names that agent. The units that the system already holds are not covered, and a unit whose responsible agent is gone waits with nobody to act on it. REQ-WC-007 already gives the state for a unit that no agent can perform, so no new state is added. To select a second agent is a judgement and DEC-030 keeps it out of this system, so the state is what the system gives and an agent decides what follows. When the system confirms the position is a mechanism and sits below this level (MET-005).
